_comment: Races settled other than by the count. RSA 660:1 sends a tie to the Secretary of State, who draws lots. The votes stay as cast; only the outcome is fixed here, so the board can call a race the arithmetic never will.

5545.note: Tied 264-264 with Sue DeLemus for the second seat. Andy Dow won the draw at the Secretary of State's office; DeLemus declined a recount.
